question: An Act passed by Parliament is enacted only after the approval of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**President**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Every bill after being passed by both houses of Parliament is presented to the President for approval(Article 111)**. There are three alternatives before the president 

 
 
• He may give **approval to the bill**.
 
• He may **withhold his approval for the bill**.
 
• He may r**eturn the bill for reconsideration of the house.**
 
• If the **bill is passed it becomes an act and is a place in the statute book.**
 
 
 
• President enjoys **suspensive veto, absolute veto, pocket veto**.
 
• Article **123 gives power to the President that he can issue ordinance when one of the houses of the Parliament is not in session. The maximum validity of an ordinance is 6 months and 6 weeks**. An ordinance will expire after 6 weeks once both houses of the Parliament are in session.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The President is the formal head of the executive, legislature and judiciary of India.
 
• He is the **first citizen of India(Article 53).** The idea of the **President is taken from United states of America.**
 
• He is the **commander-in-chief of the Indian Armed Forces.{Article 53(40}.**
 
• The election of President is done by **Single Electoral College,** which consists of the elected members of **both Houses of Parliament and the elected members of the Legislative Assemblies of all the States and also of NCT of Delhi and the Union Territory of Puducherry. (Article 54)**
 
• The President shall hold office for a term of **5 years from the date on which he enters upon his office. (Article 56)**.
 
• The oath is taken by the President in the presence of the **Chief Justice of India.** 
 
• If the President violates the law of the Constitution, he may be removed from office by **impeachment (Article 61).**
 
• The President can hand over the **resign to Vice-President**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Under Article 58, a candidate should fulfill the following eligibility conditions to contest the election to the Office of President: -

 
 
• Must be a **citizen of India**,
 
• Must have **completed 35 years of age,**
 
• Must be **eligible to be a member of Lok Sabha.**
 
 
 
• **President has the power to reduce the punishment of a person or can change the nature of punishment(Article 72).**
 
• President has emergency power and they are of three types.:
 
 
• ** National Emergency (Article 352).**
 
• **President’s rule (Article 356 & 365).**
 
• **Financial Emergency(Article 360). **
